title: Guide copy readability UI
summary: In-app informational copy keeps the same wording; paragraphs, line-height, hierarchy, and caution boxes make legal/settings/footer guides skimmable on PC and mobile.
testFocus: Legal pages: terms/privacy/commerce — same sentences, paragraph breaks, caution boxes
Settings delete-account confirm: bullets as a list, left-aligned
Mobile: extra inset, line-height, no edge-to-edge blob
asIs: Guide strings rendered as one tight paragraph (legal-doc line-height 1.55, no sentence grouping).
toBe: Same wording in GuideProse: ~2 sentences per paragraph, caution notes, lists, line-height ~1.8.
